description.html: HabiStat Arboreal Single Feeding Ledge lets arboreal species eat and drink up high, as they would in the wild. The ledge is made of black acrylic, while the cups and suction cups are clear, so you can see the contents from every angle without disturbing the animal. It measures 8 x 6 x 8 cm (length x depth x height).

Large weight-bearing suction cups hold the ledge on the glass wall of the terrarium, with no glue or drilling, and it is easy to move. The cups clip in place, come out easily, wash well and can be reused. The manufacturer also sells replacement cups separately.

The ledge is handy for crested geckos, day geckos and other arboreal species that rarely come down to the ground. A cup can hold fruit mix, insects or water. The single version is compact and takes up little space, so it suits smaller terrariums too. If you want food and water in one place, there is also the double version with two cups.
Clean the glass before mounting so the suction cups hold well, and wash the cups whenever you change the food. See ready-made terrariums for arboreal species on our terrariums page.
